source: Gallica IIIF, BnF Clairambault 349 (ciphertext) and BnF fr.20974 (key)
note: Manuscript foliation 'f.3' (per catalogue and Tomokiyo's guise.htm) corresponds to Gallica canvas f9 in btv1b9000668z (no folio labels in that manifest; offset taken from Tomokiyo's own deep link, confirmed by independent fetch, 24 Sept 2026). fr.20974's manifest also carries no folio/page labels (all 'NP'); this worker (25 Sept 2026) calibrated Gallica canvas -> printed page number by fetching page-number-corner crops of canvases 25 (p.47) and 29 (p.55) -- a clean +2-pages-per-canvas fit -- then confirmed by eye that canvas 30 (p.57) and canvas 37 (p.69) show the two key tables Tomokiyo's guise.htm crops (guise/BnFfr20974f57.png, f69.png) are cropped from. Canvas 31 (also p.57) duplicates canvas 30's content almost exactly -- likely a second scan pass of the same leaf, not a distinct page; canvas 32 (p.59) is blank on both sides.

files.content: Low-res thumbnail, superseded by clair349_f9_native.jpg below.

files.manuscript_folio: f.3 (per catalogue); dated '4. janvier 1556' (old-style; = 4 Jan. 1557 new-style) in a contemporary hand top-left of the right page, matching Tomokiyo's citation exactly
files.content: Two-leaf spread. Right page: THE ciphertext letter -- dense arbitrary-symbol/figure groups, no visible word spacing, approx. 33 lines by eye-count (not transcribed), BnF ownership stamp and archival numbers '2429'/'3' in the margin. Left page: continuous plain French cursive (the reply or a covering/docket text, not cipher).

files.manuscript_folio: f.3, right page only, full native resolution (3895x6604) for a future transcription pass
files.content: Same ciphertext page as clair349_f9_native.jpg, cropped to the right leaf only at full native resolution (not downscaled to 900px).
NO cipher. Unrelated prior material headed 'Henry 2. Grisons' (Swiss/Grey Leagues affairs), plain French, with marginal date references to 1550/1554 -- a different document, not part of this letter.

files.manuscript_folio: following leaf (f.4 per visible folio mark)
files.content: NO cipher. Left page continues the plain-French docket/reply text from f9's left page; right page blank (faint watermark, small pencil '11' only). The letter's ciphertext does not continue past f9 -- confined to one page.

files.manuscript_page: p.57 (this worker's own calibration, see manifest note; matches Tomokiyo's guise/BnFfr20974f57.png crop)
files.content: First of the two key leaves for cipher no.15 (Guise <-> Hippolyte d'Este, cardinal de Ferrare). Right page: a substitution alphabet (letters with symbol/figure equivalents, several per letter -- homophones), rows labelled 'Doubles' and 'Nullete[z]'/nulls, and below that a nomenclator table ('Nomencl[at]... ' column headers) listing numeric codes against words/names -- more complete than Tomokiyo's tight alphabet-only crop, which explicitly says the nomenclature is not shown there. Left page blank except a small top-left docket note.

files.manuscript_page: p.69 (this worker's own calibration, see manifest note; matches Tomokiyo's guise/BnFfr20974f69.png crop)
files.content: Second key leaf for the same cipher no.15. Right page: a second, denser nomenclator table in 4 columns of code:word pairs, with a small paper slip pasted into the middle of the table (a correction/addition, visible as a distinct rectangle over the text) and a 'Nomenclator' section header. Left page mostly blank with a short docket line top-left.
